items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I remember there was one time when I think it was Grady Tate and Ernie Roth, had an early morning date...

ctx.x: Because I remember there was one time when I think it was Grady Tate and Ernie Roth, had an early morning date, then there was a whole lot of time in between, until 7:00 o'clock at night, and they got into Jim and Andy's and started eating and getting logey and drinking and partying, till they had to send somebody in their place, because they couldn't cut that date in that shape.
